investigation_notes.Decoded Script Summary: The encoded command sets a URL (http://attacker.top/payload.exe), sets a local path (C:\Users\Public\updater.exe), adjusts .NET security protocol, downloads the payload via WebClient::DownloadFile($url,$path) and attempts to execute the downloaded file.
investigation_notes.Description: An encoded PowerShell command was executed as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM on GF3456 that decodes to a download-and-execute flow pulling http://attacker.top/payload.exe to C:\Users\Public\updater.exe. Prior activity shows the script file C:\Windows\Temp\system_maintenance.ps1 was created and a scheduled-task registry key was added by user a.vargas shortly before the execution, with the task run via the Schedule service (svchost.exe). The PowerShell binary hash has no AV engine detections but community votes and the combined behavior (file drop, scheduled-task creation, external download and execution) strongly indicate likely malicious activity, so this alert is High Priority.
